title: Babanın cüzdanı

characters.FATHER: a father in his late forties with short salt-and-pepper hair and a neat beard, wearing a navy blue coat
characters.GIRL: a little girl of about five with curly red-brown hair, wearing a green dress
characters.OLDFATHER: the same father, now in his seventies with white hair and a neat white beard, wearing a navy blue cardigan
characters.WOMAN: a woman of about thirty with curly red-brown hair, wearing a green coat

scenes.text:
Babanın cüzdanında,
senin çoktan unuttuğun bir şey var.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy autumn evening, {OLDFATHER} sits in an armchair by the window under a warm lamp, an old worn brown leather wallet lying on the small table beside him, rain on the glass.

scenes.text:
Beş yaşında çizdiğin,
yamuk bir ev ile iki çöp adam.
scenes.prompt: At a kitchen table in warm afternoon light, {GIRL} on the right proudly shows a simple child's crayon drawing lying on the table, and {FATHER} on the left looks at it with a big smile.

scenes.text:
Kâğıt yıllar içinde yıprandı,
köşeleri yumuşadı, rengi soldu.
scenes.prompt: In a small cafe by a rainy window, {FATHER} sits alone smiling softly, an open leather wallet and a small folded child's drawing lying on the table in front of him, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Cüzdan değişti, kartlar değişti;
o resim hep en arkada kaldı.
scenes.prompt: At night under a desk lamp, a faded, softly creased child's crayon drawing of a little house lies unfolded on a wooden desk next to an old brown leather wallet, autumn leaves on the window sill.

scenes.text:
Sen büyüdün ama onun için hâlâ
o kâğıttaki çocuksun. Bunu babana gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset by a garden gate in autumn, {WOMAN} on the left rests her head on the shoulder of {OLDFATHER} on the right, both smiling, golden leaves falling around them.

caption:
Babana sor bakalım.

Bazı babalar sevgiyi cüzdanın en arkasında taşır. 🤍

Bunu babana gönder.
